verses.1: And I sit down and open my eyes. And behold, four chariots emerge from between the two mountains. And those mountains are very high.
verses.2: In the first carriage, there were brown horses; in the second carriage, there were black horses.
verses.3: And in the three-wheeled vehicle, there are white horses; and in the four-wheeled vehicle, there are brown horses.
verses.4: And I said to the angel who spoke to me, “What are these idols?”
verses.5: And the angel said, “These are the four winds of the heavens; they come from the throne on which all the earth sits.”
verses.6: In it, the black horses go to the land of darkness, and the white horses go to their own place. And the brown horses go to the land of light.
verses.7: And they went out and tried to walk in the land. They said, “Go, walk in the land.” And they indeed walked in the land.
verses.8: And he cried out to me, and spoke to me, saying, “Look, those who go into the land of darkness have left their souls in the land of darkness.”
verses.9: And the word of Jehovah was to me:
verses.10: You came from that land, from Huldai and Toviyah. You came from Yedaya as well. You came on that day. You came to the house of Josiah, son of Zefanyah, who came from Babylon.
verses.11: And you took silver and gold, and made crowns for them. You placed them on the head of Joshua son of Jehoshua, the high priest.
verses.12: And you said to him, “As the Lord Almighty said: ‘Behold, a man named Solomon will come up from his place; and he will build the Temple for the Lord.’”
verses.13: And he will build the Temple of Jehovah. He will sit on His throne, and He will rule over it. He will be like a priest who serves at His throne. And peace will be between them both.
verses.14: And the decorations will become a reminder of goodness, wisdom, and knowledge. They will also serve as a memorial to Ben-Zefanya in the house of Jehovah.
verses.15: And from far away, they will come and dwell in the house of Jehovah. They will know that Jehovah, the Almighty, has sent me to them. And if they listen to the voice of Jehovah, your God, then they will be saved.
